title: Layered Past Participial Modifiers
grammar: Passive and anterior -t/-tt participial modifiers with agents and time phrases
goal: I can form and interpret past/passive participles (-t/-tt) as pre-nominal modifiers.
I can attach time adverbials, locations, and 'által' agents inside a -t/-tt participial clause.
I can describe relics of the past, aged objects, and cherished memories.
